entries.c263caccd2abdaf3: A medium-term management plan has been formulated with a three-year plan period from the fiscal year ending March 2027 to the fiscal year ending March 2029. In the clerical personnel services business, the company will pursue a dual expansion of both the regions where it operates and the operational areas it covers, centered on its main BPO-related business division in transactions with local governments, and will also work to expand business in transactions with private companies. In the manufacturing personnel services business, the company aims to move away from a mainly dispatch-based business by expanding contracting and personnel referral operations, and will strengthen its sales bases. As new business development, the company will expand the operational areas of BPO services for private companies in the clerical business, and in manufacturing will enter new operational areas centered on highly skilled foreign national staff, and it states that it will actively invest in DX, including the use of AI, infrastructure development and the recruitment of highly skilled personnel.
